content: While converting some code from List to Array, Claude noticed that List.ofFn is @[expose]'d but Array.ofFn is not. Is the latter intentional? I am new to lean and don't understand all the implications of this, but Claude told me that it means that a module importer's kernel cannot unfold it.
This has just been fixed in lean#14989, the v4.35.0-rc1 release in a few days will include the change.

In the meantime HexBasic.OfFn provides kernel-reducible Hex.Array.ofFn' and Hex.Vector.ofFn' shims, if that’s useful:

https://github.com/kim-em/hex-dev/blob/main/HexBasic/OfFn.lean
